title: Narak mein pade atma Tirthankar ban sakti hai?
hooks: Narak mein padi atma Tirthankar ban sakti hai?
Raja Shrenik narak gaye the, phir bhi Tirthankar banenge?
Mahavir ke bhakt Shrenik ka ant kya hua?
hook_why: Direct question hits the core curiosity immediately; mentions 'hell' and 'Tirthankara' in first 5 words for maximum swipe-stop power.
metaphor: A lotus blooming from muddy water — the soul's purity emerges despite current circumstances.
mechanism: Death and rebirth in hell due to past karma
Constant remembrance of Mahavira in hell
Soul ascends to become Tirthankara in next cycle

cast.King Shrenik: Middle-aged king with trimmed beard, gold crown with central jewel, rich embroidered dhoti and angavastram in deep red and gold, calm regal face, hands folded in reverence
cast.Mahavira Swami: Serene meditating idol only — seated padmasana on white marble simhasana, half-closed eyes, gentle smile, srivatsa mark on chest, lion emblem at base, golden aura, no action poses
cast.Jain Monk: Plain white unstitched cotton robes (two pieces), soft white whisk broom (rajoharan) in hand, shaved head, peaceful expression, walking barefoot on marble

claims.claim: King Shrenik (Bimbisara) was a devoted follower of Mahavira
Shrenik was reborn in hell due to a karmic error
His repentance (paschatap) in hell purified his soul
He is destined to become a Tirthankara in the next cosmic cycle (kalpa)
Source text is Trishashti-shalaka-purusha-charitra by Acharya Hemachandra

figures.name: Mahavira Swami (Idol)
figures.look: Smooth white marble idol seated in padmasana posture. Small tight curls cover the bare head. A srivatsa mark adorns the chest. A lion emblem sits on the pedestal. Eyes remain half-closed in deep meditation. Serene, polished stone surface with plain features.

figures.name: King Shrenik
figures.look: Middle-aged king with a trimmed black beard and calm expression. Wears a golden crown with a central ruby. Draped in a rich red-gold silk angavastram over a bare chest. Hands held in anjali mudra. Dignified, royal, and peaceful posture throughout.

places.name: Jain Temple
places.look: Grand white marble structure with tall, pointed shikhara spires and stepped stone roofs. Intricately carved pillars and sandstone accents. Warm golden light bathes the white stone. A temple tank with clear water and lotuses sits at the base of the steps.

places.name: Palace Courtyard
places.look: Open courtyard of polished white marble and warm sandstone. Finely carved pillars support the structure. View of distant temple spires. Soft golden sunlight creates long shadows on the clean floor. Elegant, ancient Indian royal architecture with open, airy vistas.

places.name: Symbolic Cavern
places.look: Vast cavernous space with a faint crimson glow. A singular, brilliant beam of golden light descends from above. A lone lotus bud rises from dark, still water. Painterly textures with deep shadows and ethereal, warm highlights create a contemplative atmosphere.

places.name: Cosmic Realm
places.look: A massive stone wheel of time with carved spokes. Above it, a radiant white crescent-shaped realm floats in a golden sky. Luminous souls appear as points of light ascending toward the apex. Ethereal, serene, and vast ancient cosmic geography.

places.name: Temple Library
places.look: Quiet chamber with white marble pillars. Ancient palm-leaf manuscripts rest on carved wooden stands. Warm golden light filters through stone lattices. A peaceful atmosphere filled with the texture of aged parchment and polished, cool stone surfaces.

places.name: Gift Box Scene
places.look: A simple, elegant box wrapped in textured paper, emitting a soft internal golden glow. Rests on a clean white marble surface. Minimalist and peaceful presentation under warm, diffused lighting with a soft focus and uncluttered background.
